extraction.name: Visual Genome
extraction.description: A dataset of over 108,249 real-world images from Flickr, densely annotated with region descriptions, objects, attributes, relationships, region graphs, scene graphs, and question-answer pairs to support cognitive computer vision tasks and scene understanding.
extraction.creator: Ranjay Krishna, Yuke Zhu, Oliver Groth, Justin Johnson, Kenji Hata, Joshua Kravitz, Stephanie Chen, Yannis Kalantidis, Li-Jia Li, David A. Shamma, Michael S. Bernstein, Li Fei-Fei
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Visual Genome was collected and verified entirely by crowd workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk. Workers created region descriptions, extracted objects from descriptions, added attributes and relationships, drew bounding boxes, wrote freeform and region-based question-answer pairs, and annotations were verified using majority voting and rapid judgments.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Some region descriptions contain no objects and therefore have no region graphs associated with them.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Real-world, non-iconic images uploaded to Flickr; the first release uses 108,249 images from the intersection of YFCC100M and MS-COCO.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Collected over the course of 6 months after 15 months of experimentation and iteration on the data representation.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Descriptions and QAs were canonicalized to WordNet synsets; objects, attributes, and relationships were merged across region graphs into scene graphs using overlap heuristics and worker confirmation; noun phrases were extracted with Stanford NLP tools; attributes were normalized by stemming; relationships were mapped using WordNet sentence frames and root hypernyms.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Workers were instructed to write diverse descriptions and questions; descriptions were filtered using BLEU thresholds against prior descriptions; bounding boxes had to satisfy coverage and quality constraints; objects, attributes, and relationships were verified; descriptions and QAs were lowercased, lemmatized, and stripped of excess whitespace/non-alphanumeric characters for experiments.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Workers wrote region descriptions for localized bounding boxes, extracted objects and drew tight bounding boxes, added attributes and relationships to form region graphs, merged region graphs into scene graphs, and wrote freeform and region-based question-answer pairs. Annotations were verified after collection.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All components except objects were verified using majority voting with three unique workers and acceptance by at least two workers. Objects were verified using rapid judgments. Canonicalization mappings were manually checked against alternative synsets; precision, recall, and mapping accuracy were reported for objects, attributes, and relationships.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: On average, each image has 50 region descriptions, 17 question-answer pairs, 21 objects, 18 attributes, and 18 relationships.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Over 33,000 unique workers; 93.02% from the United States, with additional workers from the Philippines, Kenya, India, Russia, Canada, and others. The majority were aged 25-34; youngest 18 and oldest 68; 54.15% male and 45.85% female.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Stanford CoreNLP natural language processing toolkit, including Stanford dependency parser; BLEU scoring was used programmatically to filter similar descriptions.
